findings.summary: The clone ended in a verified whiteout; live execution remains forbidden.
findings.observed_fact: Birdlaw fainted to Eelektrik's Shock Wave with Eelektrik still at 42/54 HP.

findings.summary: The Ponyta branch again pivoted at the first unsafe-looking boundary instead of using the verified two-Bulldoze line.

resolution.observed: Replay from turn 005 used Bulldoze twice: the first action left Lildozer alive at 10/58 with Ponyta at 5/49, and the second action fainted Ponyta with no enemy reply. The new profile now enforces this exact two-turn line when its verified HP predicates match.

findings.observed_fact: The selected switch sequence consumed 10 additional actions before Coppertop finally removed Ponyta.

findings.summary: Because the Ponyta branch spent 21 switches and depleted the team, the status-safe Croakatoa converter was no longer a survivable Eelektrik entry.
findings.observed_fact: At Eelektrik entry Croakatoa was 17/44 and the policy chose Bushtank at 23/57; Croakatoa then fainted on a later Shock Wave.

findings.summary: The Eelektrik policy had no verified healthy-converter guard at the Coppertop boundary, so it selected a poisoned Razor Leaf pivot and spent the remaining party as emergency switches.
findings.observed_fact: Bushtank was poisoned on its first Razor Leaf, used it again, fainted, and the remaining line made 15 further switches without a KO.

findings.summary: The line used 21 switches and only nine move actions; six party members were consumed before Eelektrik was removed.
The policy continued the poisoned Bushtank Razor Leaf line after the first status confirmation instead of preserving a clean reserve for the converter transition.
The 30-action loss was much slower than the historical 22-action win; tempo remains secondary to restoring a safe Eelektrik entry.

correct_choices: Spark removed Bibarel with verified Super Fang handling.
Coppertop's Bulldoze correctly finished the weakened Ponyta once it was finally selected.
All 30 action results matched authoritative RAM without an execution or observation discrepancy.
agent_review.next_test: Do not start another clone until this review is persisted. Verify the enforced two-Bulldoze Ponyta branch first; then test whether a healthy Croakatoa Fake Out/Sludge Eelektrik line is available before adding another exception.
